scope: Proposed gates for M0 review. Nothing here authorizes implementation, infrastructure or shared-family launch.

permission_matrix.actors: Two synthetic adults, two synthetic households, child member without Auth identity, no real family data
required_layers: authorized isolated PG with actual application role
permission_matrix.proposed_gate: 0 unauthorized reads/writes/exports/dispatches, 0 private-title leaks, deny by default; no skip counted as pass
permission_matrix.required_evidence: Pinned migration/grants/runtime-role/protocol manifest, exact fixture IDs and all denominators, minimal authorized response bodies, transaction/audit receipts, independent reviewer

command_unknown_cases.name: 同key同hash重放返回原receipt
command_unknown_cases.expect: One command identity, one aggregate revision, one outbox event; return same result after timeout/restart

command_unknown_cases.name: 同key异hash冲突
command_unknown_cases.expect: 409, no mutation, do not reveal unauthorized prior result

command_unknown_cases.name: 旧expected_revision不覆盖新事实
command_unknown_cases.expect: 409 plus only authorized minimal diff; preserve client draft

command_unknown_cases.name: 超时先查原command
command_unknown_cases.expect: GET original receipt distinguishes processing/applied/rejected/not_found; 202 is not applied

command_unknown_cases.name: not_found后合同允许才重发同identity
command_unknown_cases.expect: No blind retry/new command ID after outcome_unknown; prove original nonexecution first

command_unknown_cases.name: 撤权后receipt投影最小化
command_unknown_cases.expect: 403/invisible according to frozen contract; do not leak object title or payload in error/diff

command_unknown_cases.name: 并发首次同key提交
command_unknown_cases.expect: Independent instances submit simultaneously; one durable result and no duplicate effect

command_unknown_cases.name: 领域revision receipt outbox原子性
command_unknown_cases.expect: Inject failure at every write boundary; all commit or none, stable retry identity

command_unknown_cases.name: 外部unknown不可重发
command_unknown_cases.expect: Keep original dispatch ID and target digest; reconcile observation without new side effect
command_unknown_cases.layer: device/external substitute then authorized real receipt

command_unknown_cases.name: worker冻结快照后撤权
command_unknown_cases.expect: Revalidate membership/visibility/generation after model return and before write/dispatch

command_unknown_cases.name: 跨家庭复合父子引用
command_unknown_cases.expect: Reject link in actual database constraints and service, not only JSON validation

command_unknown_cases.name: 旧客户端未知卡与错误兼容
command_unknown_cases.expect: Readable summary and no unknown action; 401 differs from Auth 503; capability/version declared

memory_cases.name: 纠正版本记录新来源链
memory_cases.expect: Subject/visibility/source kind/ref/revision/time retained; correction links previous version and new current-user source

memory_cases.name: 迟到正文CAS冲突
memory_cases.expect: Old revision returns 409, latest correction wins without losing draft

memory_cases.name: 删除后同operation不可复活
memory_cases.expect: Tombstone/generation fences original operation replay and late worker

memory_cases.name: 删除清除派生索引摘要提醒缓存
memory_cases.expect: All relevant projections stop using source; export/deletion scope has durable receipt

memory_cases.name: 来源删除使关联记忆重审
memory_cases.expect: Deleted/expired source cannot remain active evidence; privacy scope cannot expand

memory_cases.name: 召回冻结后撤权仍需停止dispatch
memory_cases.expect: No wrong subject/private/retracted source injection after revocation

memory_cases.name: 健康观察与推断必须区分
memory_cases.expect: Sensitive/inferred/shared-scope changes require explicit confirmation; no diagnosis claim from observation

memory_cases.name: journal失败保留可恢复来源
memory_cases.expect: Claim/lease then save and consume atomically; failure keeps original fragments recoverable

memory_cases.name: 瞬时原媒体到期清扫
memory_cases.expect: Frozen TTL and explicit retention choice; deletion/orphan cleanup has bytes and receipt evidence

memory_cases.name: 虚构中文跨会话质量集
memory_cases.expect: Freeze >=100 examples and denominator; proposed recall@6>=90%, wrong-subject/retracted injection=0, old correction used next turn=0

log_cases.name: 异常日志合成敏感标记为零
log_cases.actual: Captured proactive logger arguments contain synthetic canary; safe logger/metrics controls do not

log_cases.name: 原生OS日志无payload正文或工具参数
log_cases.expect: Bounded synthetic markers absent, including error and SSE/tool argument paths

log_cases.name: 无内容trace可拼时序
log_cases.expect: 30 frozen synthetic traces complete admission/command/dispatch/receipt phases; only allowed metadata, rotating/nonlinkable identity, no child text/media/token/tool body
